[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] had a '''private balcony''' at the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]]. He sat there with his [[Senior Administrative Aide|staff aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] during a performance of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]''<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> in [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref>
